item.description:
Koegaki 1.8.0

  • Custom words. Add the names and terms you use on the Vocabulary page, and Koegaki can write them the way you spelled them when it hears them split, hyphenated or in a different case: post hog becomes PostHog, X code becomes Xcode.
  • Replacements still run last and win where the two overlap. A word that differs only in case is changed only when your spelling is several words or has a capital inside a lowercase word, like PostHog or iPhone, so adding US never changes us.
  • Custom words change only how matching words are written, never what Koegaki hears, and they never leave your Mac. A term with punctuation other than hyphens and apostrophes, such as Node.js, or written outside the Latin, Greek and Cyrillic alphabets is left as heard.
